blocks.text: To train specialists with humanities and socio-economic education who meet the national interests of the country and are competitive in the modern labour market.
BSU principles: • Dynamic development • International recognition • Flexibility • Accessibility • Labour-market relevance

BSU priorities: • Improving educational quality • Modernising secondary and higher education programmes • Introducing modern educational technologies • Strengthening research • Developing academic mobility for faculty and students • Integration into the global educational space
Reapproved by the Academic Council, minutes No. 3 of 1 December 2023.
